page: Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features an x86_64 architecture with 48 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type is equipped with 2835 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-speed local data access. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. The instance does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high memory density and substantial local NVMe storage, the EC48eds_v6 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets and fast local scratch space. It is designed for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics pipelines that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and high memory-to-core ratios.
